title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 105 Duff Street in Macon, Missouri, as the "Arla W. Harrell Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 105 Duff Street in Macon, Missouri, as the "Arla W. Harrell Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named the post office at 105 Duff Street in Macon, Missouri, after Arla W. Harrell.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility in Macon, Missouri, located at 105 Duff Street. The building will now be officially called the Arla W. Harrell Post Office. It does not change postal services, rules, or fees.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 13, 2018.
